component.name: GPUI Starter
component.summary: A full-featured desktop application boilerplate built with GPUI (Zed's UI toolkit)

description.p: GPUI Starter is a desktop application boilerplate built on GPUI, the UI toolkit behind the Zed editor. It ships the production wiring a real app needs: multi-page navigation, themes, internationalization, form validation, notifications, secure storage, SQLite persistence, and a signed auto-updater.
Harden Linux notifications with the XDG portal backend, add a universal macOS DMG, and fix release CI.
